condition_description: Metric explicitly documented in a system of record or customer plan
reason: Strongest KPI case because customer metric already exists in a formal record

condition_description: Metric with explicit current value or target value already documented
reason: Clear measurable KPI with formal source of truth

condition_description: Customer explicitly confirms a measurable success criterion even if not in a formal system
reason: Strong KPI because customer confirmed it in relationship workflow

condition_description: Measurable goal repeatedly discussed across meetings notes or messages
reason: Good working KPI candidate even if not formally documented

condition_description: Measurable target repeatedly discussed but still partially specified
reason: Needs human review before becoming KPI

condition_description: Blocker repeatedly described as required for rollout renewal or expansion
reason: Could become a KPI if the team wants success-condition blockers elevated

condition_description: Operational blocker with no measurable success framing
reason: Should stay blocker by default

condition_description: Time-bound delivery or launch item tied to customer success
reason: Important item but should not automatically become KPI

condition_description: Feature request without measurable success framing
reason: Product signal not KPI

condition_description: General positive or negative commentary with no measurable success condition
reason: Useful context for humans or health but not KPI

condition_description: Signal influences health interpretation but is not itself a tracked KPI
reason: Keep for scoring context without creating KPI row

condition_description: Internal task or milestone not explicitly tied to customer outcome
reason: Should never become customer KPI

condition_description: Measurable rollout usage or enablement metric
reason: Common KPI family across many sources

condition_description: Measurable time saved response time turnaround or process improvement metric
reason: Common KPI family when tied to customer outcome

condition_description: Measurable ticket reduction self-service or support deflection metric
reason: High-value KPI family for support use cases

condition_description: Measurable commercial outcome or expansion threshold tied to customer success
reason: Valid KPI when it reflects real account success condition

condition_description: Measurable renewal readiness or value continuity metric
reason: Valid KPI when framed as measurable account outcome

condition_description: Structured satisfaction metric such as NPS or CSAT
reason: Already a recognized measurable KPI family

condition_description: Metric-like statement mentioned once with weak evidence
reason: Should remain suggestion until more evidence arrives

condition_description: Broad business outcome with enough specificity to measure over time
reason: May become KPI if the team agrees the outcome is specific enough
